workflow_description: Handles the ingestion and validation of data from diverse .NET sources, ensuring uniform processing regardless of the origin.
Manages global configuration profiles and controls the routing of table output to various system channels or custom writers.
Maintains visual consistency and structural alignment by calculating display widths for complex characters and managing word-wrapping.
Supports the transformation of table data into different presentation styles, including Markdown and minimal formats, while preserving data integrity.
Governs the inclusion of summary metadata and applies specific legibility standards to numeric data columns within the report.
Manages the automatic generation of unique identification metadata for business entities.
integration_test: [Fact] public void DomainIdentityManagement_Workflow_AssignsUniqueIdentifiersToEntities() { var entities = new List<Something> { new Something(), new Something(), new Something() }; var ids = entities.Select(e => e.Id).ToList(); Assert.Equal(3, ids.Distinct().Count()); Assert.All(ids, id => { Assert.False(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(id)); Assert.Equal(32, id.Length); }); var table = ConsoleTable.From(entities); var output = table.ToString(); foreach (var id in ids) { Assert.Contains(id, output); } Assert.Contains("Id", output); Assert.Contains("Name", output); Assert.Contains("Date", output); }
